other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must be a building or construction worker
Applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Female construction workers are eligible in case of maternity, provided they have a valid identity card
Male construction workers are eligible in case of their wife's delivery, provided they have a valid identity card
benefits_summary: Free medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per year for registered workers and their families.
